body:
### Summary

When the venv path contains an apostrophe, activate.bat writes VIRTUAL_ENV with bash-style escaping ('"'"'), so the venv doesn't actually activate in cmd.

```
C:\Tools\it's a test> uv venv
Using CPython 3.15.2 interpreter at: C:\Users\Lewis\AppData\Local\Python\pythoncore-3.15-64\python.exe
Creating virtual environment at: .venv
Activate with: .venv\Scripts\activate

C:\Tools\it's a test> .venv\Scripts\activate.bat

C:\Tools\it's a test> echo %VIRTUAL_ENV%
C:\Tools\it'"'"'s a test\.venv
```

### Platform

Windows 11 x86_64

### Version

uv 0.13.7 (316c827e0 2026-11-03 x86_64-pc-windows-msvc)

### Python version

3.15.2
title: activate.bat sets wrong VIRTUAL_ENV when the path contains an apostrophe
